# ChatGPT & Codex changelog — captured 2026-08-21
# Source used: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog
# (sources.json still points at developers.openai.com/codex/changelog, which 308s here)

### August 20, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- **Apple Messages plugin** — read and search Messages chats on Mac, prepare and send messages.
  All plans. Installed from Plugins > Public. Covers **iMessage, SMS and RCS**.
  Requires **FULL DISK ACCESS** in System Settings + contact-name access + automation access.
  **Apple Silicon (arm64) build of the desktop app ONLY** — not Intel Macs, not web, not mobile,
  not Codex CLI, not the IDE extension. Usable from ChatGPT Work AND Codex.
  Sends need approval by default; **"Always allow sending to this chat"** makes it permanent for
  that conversation (OpenAI warns this removes the final review).
  NOTE: no dedicated doc page found — /docs/plugins/apple-messages 404s. Detail via WebSearch
  (MacRumors, 9to5Mac, Unite.AI, iClarified, all 2026-08-20).   [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/ENDPOINT]
- **Computer History available in the EEA, Switzerland and the UK** for Pro/Business/Enterprise —
  the three jurisdictions excluded when it shipped Aug 13.       [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- Site co-editing (workspace owners invite editors with read/update); editable Site URLs.  [held]
- Shared read-only Codex thread snapshots from the desktop app.                            [held]
- Unified pinned threads across desktop and iOS.                                          [held]
- Codex CLI 0.149.0: interactive agents dashboard, `/cd` `/pwd` `/cwd`, `codex queue`, expanded Vim,
  `codex doctor` network/proxy/desktop diagnostics, `max`/`ultra` reasoning effort.        [held]

### August 19, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- **GitLab support (BETA)** — connect GitLab projects to Codex cloud, create environments against
  them, **trigger tasks from issues and merge requests using `@codex`**, **enable automatic
  reviews**. Setup covers webhook permissions + MR reviews. First non-GitHub code host.
  Dedicated doc page not resolvable (developers.openai.com/codex/gitlab -> learn.chatgpt.com/docs/
  gitlab = 404; /docs/codex/gitlab = 404). Cited /docs/cloud.  [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AISPM]

### August 18, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.223: direct Codex Remote launch, MCP forms support, linked folder
  improvements, voice reliability, diff review performance.                               [held]
- **Codex CLI 0.148.0**: `/export` conversations to Markdown; session forking + archiving; draft
  prompts during TUI init; thread credits/cost in `/status`; **Amazon Bedrock Runtime as a built-in
  provider**; **asynchronous MCP tool invocation in hooks**.
  The Bedrock provider compounds two known facts: Anthropic's Compliance API explicitly does NOT
  capture Claude Code routed via Bedrock/GCP/Foundry, and as of 2026-08-19 bedrock-runtime serves
  the Anthropic Messages API on its /anthropic route.        [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM/ENDPOINT]

### August 13 / 11 / 10, 2026 — all reported 2026-08-14
Computer History (macOS, opt-in, accessibility-event capture, ephemeral Codex session summarizes to
local plain-text memory files, 48h on-device buffer, admin grant for Business/Enterprise);
Import from another agent (Claude Code / Claude Cowork / Cursor, with automatic sync); Daybreak Blue
and Daybreak Red tiers (GPT-5.5-Cyber / GPT-5.6-Cyber; 95% vs 1.5% on advanced cyber prompts);
Linux desktop preview (.deb/.rpm, x64 + ARM64).

### STILL OPEN — sixth consecutive scan
`gpt-realtime-2.1` / `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini`: forum-only since ~2026-07-06, still absent from SDK
changelogs, platform docs and this changelog.

Updated: 2026-08-21 — FOUR new dated entries (Aug 18, 19, 20). GitLab and Apple Messages are the
two reportable surfaces; the Bedrock provider matters mainly as a cross-vendor blind-spot compound.
</content>
